newsitem.title: USA: Rohm & Haas says will work with Advanced Lighting.
newsitem.headline: Rohm & Haas says will work with Advanced Lighting.

text.p: Rohm and Haas Co said it has agreed with Advanced Lighting Technologies Inc to make products for the remote source lighting market.

Rohm and Haas said they will make illuminators and components compatible with the OptiFlex light pipe, its proprietary solid core fiberoptic cable that distributes light from a remote lighting source.
The company said remote source lighting is used in retail display cases and swimming pools.
